title: Bootstrap Quiz
description: Check what you know about Bootstrap buttons, cards and page layouts. Read the reason after each answer, and try again when you are ready.

questions.question: What is Bootstrap mainly used for?
options: Adding ready-made styles and page parts
questions.explanation: Bootstrap gives you CSS styles and page parts. You choose them with class names in your HTML.

questions.question: You added class="btn btn-primary", but the button is still plain. What should you check first?
options: Whether the button text has ten letters
Whether the page has a photo
Whether you have made a new account
questions.explanation: Class names only work when their CSS rules are loaded. Add the Bootstrap CSS file to the page, as shown in the setup lesson.

questions.question: Which order is used for a basic Bootstrap grid?
questions.explanation: The container holds the layout. A row goes inside it. Columns go inside the row, so the boxes line up together.

questions.question: What does col-12 col-md-6 do?
options: It gives a box full width on small screens and half width from md up
It always makes a box 6 pixels wide
It hides the box on all phones
It adds 12 photos to a page
questions.explanation: The grid has 12 parts. col-12 uses all 12. From the md screen size, col-md-6 uses 6 of those parts, which is half.

questions.question: Which pair of classes gives a button its basic shape and main theme colour?
questions.explanation: btn adds the basic button style. btn-primary chooses the main theme colour. The colour is blue in the default Bootstrap theme.

questions.question: Which class adds the main inner space for the words inside a card?
questions.explanation: card-body is the inner part of a card. It gives the words some room away from the outer edge.

questions.question: A visible label helps people understand what to type in a form field.
questions.explanation: A label tells the reader what a field is for. Match the label for value to the input id so they are linked.

questions.question: How should a success alert tell the reader that something worked?
options: With a clear message, such as "Your work is saved"
questions.explanation: Use words to explain the result. Colour can help too, but people should not have to see a colour to understand the message.

questions.question: The 3 in p-3 means exactly 3 pixels of padding.
questions.explanation: The number is a step on Bootstrap's spacing scale. In the default theme, p-3 gives 1rem of space inside the box.

questions.question: Which class centres text inside its box?
questions.explanation: text-center lines up the words in the centre of their box. It does not move the box itself.

questions.question: A navbar with a menu that opens and closes needs Bootstrap JavaScript as well as CSS.
questions.explanation: The CSS styles the navbar. The Bootstrap collapse JavaScript handles opening and closing the menu.

questions.question: A button should open the modal whose id is bookHelp. Which target is correct?
questions.explanation: data-bs-target points to the modal id. The # means "find this id". Bootstrap 5 uses data-bs- names.

questions.question: Which attribute asks Bootstrap 5.3 to use dark colours on a part of the page?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5.3 supports data-bs-theme="dark". Its colour rules use that setting for the chosen part and the elements inside it.

questions.question: Set a Bootstrap Sass variable before the main Bootstrap import if you want that value to be used while building its CSS.
questions.explanation: Sass makes CSS before the page is shown. Set your chosen value before the Bootstrap import so Bootstrap can use it when building the styles.
